drhp.business: The Company manufactures TMT bars and billets, marketed under its premiere TMT brand "Rudra TMX", produced from premium quality billets. It forms part of the Rudra Group, which is also engaged in Ship Recycling, Induction Furnace and Re-rolling mill businesses.
drhp.expansion: As part of its expansion strategy, the Company successfully completed trial runs of a new rolling mill in December 2022, doubling TMT Bar manufacturing capacity from 1.2 lakh tons to 2.4 lakh tons per annum. The recently completed manufacturing capacity expansion continues to provide a platform for long-term growth. The Company also executed key agreements during the year to establish a solar/wind farm as part of transitioning captive energy requirements toward renewable sourcing.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- integration: Part of the Rudra Group's backward- and forward-integrated steel businesses (Ship Recycling, Induction Furnace, Re-rolling mill) — evidence: group turnover of around Rs. 800 Crore per annum across these integrated businesses.
- scale: Doubled TMT Bar manufacturing capacity from 1.2 lakh tons to 2.4 lakh tons per annum following trial runs of a new rolling mill completed in December 2022 — evidence: stated capacity doubling disclosed in Review of Business Operations.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Enhancing operational efficiencies, exploring new markets, and driving value creation.
- Strengthening the balance sheet, improving cash flows, and maintaining prudent financial discipline to navigate market cycles.
- Progressively transitioning captive energy requirements from 10% to 100% renewable sourcing, aligned with sustainable and green growth.
